model.name: R19.59: Room construction persist must load persisted members/files/chat BEFORE writing — never wipe existing data.
model.description: BUG (HeartSpace loss): Room.createRoom() / construction persist writes a fresh scenario unit that WIPES previously persisted members[], files[], and lastMessageIor. FIX: Room construction MUST load the existing persisted scenario unit FIRST (if it exists), merge any new construction-time fields into the loaded state, THEN persist. The load-before-write order ensures offline-retained members (R19.8/8.A), uploaded files (R19.46), and chat history (R19.40) survive server restart and Room re-creation.
model.tronQuote: > PO diagnosis (HeartSpace loss): persistent rooms must NOT lose offline-retained members on restart/createRoom — Room must load persisted members/files/chat BEFORE/at construction persist. Bug: construction persist wiped members.
model.crossRefNote: R19.8 (persistent offline retention), R19.8.A (flip not prune), R19.46 (Room.files[] IOR list), R19.40 (Room.lastMessageIor) — all of these depend on persisted state surviving construction. R19.59 fixes the load-before-write bug that destroyed that state.
